name: Platoon AI
description:
Platoon turns your interviews and meetings into searchable, AI-generated notes and transcripts. This connector gives Claude read-only access to your own Platoon content so you can work with it in conversation.

Once connected, Claude can:
- List your interviews, most recent first
- Pull an interview's metadata and its available notes
- Read AI-generated notes — Key Summary, Q&A Script, Full Note, and more — as structured markdown
- Read the full transcript, with or without speaker labels

Use it to summarize a past interview, find quotes and themes across conversations, answer follow-up questions grounded in what was actually said, or draft a deck or memo straight from your notes.

Access is scoped per user via OAuth: Claude only ever sees interviews in projects you belong to, and every tool is strictly read-only — nothing is created, edited, or deleted. Authentication is handled by Platoon's identity provider, and Platoon never receives your Claude data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Platoon AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Platoon AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.pltn.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Platoon AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Platoon AI provides these MCP tools: get_interview, get_notes, get_transcript, list_interviews, and list_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Platoon AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Platoon AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Platoon AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Platoon AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Platoon AI is developed by Platoon AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
